releases.title: Design overhaul — new navigation, surfaces and type
items: The sidebar is now a full labelled navigation — Search, Dashboard, To Do, Jobs, Schedule, Reporting, Boards and Settings by name, with a red rail marking where you are, on a deep warm-black panel.
New surface system across the app: rounded cards with soft layered shadows on the dashboard KPIs, reporting cards, tables, modals and drawers — everything sits on a warmer paper background.
Bigger, more confident type: the dashboard greeting and KPI numbers get the full serif treatment; view titles and labels follow one scale.
Softer chrome everywhere: rounded buttons and inputs, warm thin scrollbars, a gentle fade when switching sections, and dimmed-blur backdrops behind modals and search.
Same platform, same layout logic — nothing moved, it just looks like it was designed on purpose.

releases.title: Full refinement pass — durability fixes + design system tidy-up
items: Fixed 5 data-loss bugs found in a full code review: jobs created natively were silently deleted by the next sync; archiving or starring a job reverted within 5 minutes; deleting a Streamtime job brought it back on the next sync; a failed sync could discard a job\'s native activity/expenses; natively-logged time double-counted once Streamtime ingested the same entry.
Editing a job\'s date or status from the header no longer records the change twice in the Activity log.
Profitability tab: the "cost is an estimate" flag now reports honestly — it was effectively always off because Streamtime cost rates are pre-defaulted.
Special characters (quotes, angle brackets) in job names, task titles and time-entry notes no longer break rendering in the activity log, tooltips, job list, alerts or label chips.

Design tidy-up across the app: one primary-button style everywhere, one badge/pill shape language, consistent tab styling (red active underline everywhere), semantic status colours unified, keyboard focus outlines added, hover transitions and a real loading spinner, and 5 duplicate conflicting CSS blocks removed.

releases.title: Per-task done sync, profitability tab, deadline risk, header tidy-up
items: To Do board: a task now moves to Done the moment its time is logged in Streamtime and synced — per task, not per day. Previously a finished task lingered in the To Do column until the whole day\'s work had landed.

New Profitability tab on every job — revenue vs cost vs margin %, with a budget-vs-actual view. Staff cost is derived (Streamtime has no cost rate for most people, so their time is valued at the $150/h default) and flagged as an estimate where that applies.
Dashboard: new "Deadline risk" card — live jobs not yet overdue but whose remaining hours can\'t realistically fit the days left.

Job header tidy-up: the duplicated status (the "Live job" workflow badge and a separate "In Play" pill) is now a single control — click the label to set status, click the arrow to advance the stage. Start and due dates now match each other\'s styling.
Cross-tab live sync: a change made in one open tab (archive a job, log time, etc.) now refreshes other open tabs automatically.
Fixed: editing a task could attach it to the wrong job (the job picker matched job numbers loosely); plus a primary button in several dialogs that had been rendering unstyled.

releases.title: Native data now persists — survives reload & sync
items: Big one: anything you create or edit natively in the platform — job name/date/status edits, milestones, expenses, added phases/items, split invoices, activity notes, and logged time — now survives a page reload AND the background Streamtime sync. Previously all of it lived in memory only and silently vanished on refresh, which made native data untrustworthy. It\'s now written to a durable local store and re-applied after every sync.
Fixed: editing a task could pre-select / save the wrong job — the job picker matched job numbers as substrings (so "677" matched "6774", etc.). Now matches the exact job number.
Global Search (⌘K) now also searches invoices and quotes, not just jobs/clients/tasks/items.
Workspace export/import now includes native quotes and the new native-data store, so a backup captures everything.

releases.title: Phase 2: native job editing, milestones, folded-in time logging
items: Job detail: click to edit job name, start date, due date, and status directly — backed by a new dbUpdateJob() stub, API-ready like the other db* functions. Edits survive the next Streamtime sync (kept in j._native and re-applied after every refresh)
Milestones are now natively creatable/editable/deletable from the job detail Timeline tab, merged alongside Streamtime-sourced milestones (tagged "ST") and preserved across syncs the same way

Time logging is back, folded into the existing mark-task-done flow instead of a separate Log Time modal (which felt redundant and was removed in v2.20.1) — completing a task now offers an hours field, pre-filled with the planned time, that logs straight into Progress tab / job detail Time used
Reporting → Jobs job filter dropdown verified working end-to-end (was wired up in v2.20.13)

releases.title: Wire up the Reporting Jobs tab job filter
items: Reporting → Jobs now has a job picker dropdown — getFilteredTasks() already had the matching logic wired in, it was just missing the actual #r-job select element, so the filter had been a permanent no-op

releases.title: Settings width, full-codebase bug review
items: Settings page was capped at 860px wide regardless of screen size — widened to 1180px
Fixed: reassigning a task to another person while viewing a non-current week silently moved it to an arbitrary other week instead of the one being viewed
Fixed: Boards person-card "this week" stats actually followed whatever week the Todo/Schedule board was last left on, not necessarily this week

Fixed: Reporting → Business company filter used startsWith on job numbers, so filtering to job "12" also pulled in hours from job 120, 123, 1234, etc. — same substring bug class fixed elsewhere in the v2.20.2 data audit, this call site had been missed
Removed a dead duplicate toggleTaskDone() definition that function hoisting had made unreachable — no behaviour change, just a maintenance trap removed

releases.title: Activity comments, weekly Happiness check-in
items: Job detail Activity tab: add a free-text note directly to the timeline — for decisions/context that don\'t have their own automatic event, not just a record of what changed in the UI
Activity tab: Streamtime logged-time entries now show billable/non-billable and $ value, not just hours

New weekly Happiness check-in — a one-tap mood prompt on Dashboard (skippable), with an 8-week trend on your Profile in Settings. Personal to this device — there\'s no shared backend yet, so this isn\'t a cross-team aggregated report, just a personal tracker

releases.title: Fix Custom board job cards breaking after first click
items: Fixed: expanding a job card on a Custom board silently lost its drag handle and delete button — it was rebuilding from the wrong template after the first click
Custom board job cards now show the same expanded task list + "Open job plan" button the Client board\'s cards already had

releases.title: Sidebar cleanup, invoices view fix, sort cycle, deadlines polish
items: Removed the separate Starred sidebar icon/panel — the star icon inside global search already covers it
Reordered sidebar: Search, Dashboard, To Do, Jobs, Schedule, Reporting, Boards, Settings
Invoices: ticking "Uninvoiced jobs" now replaces the list instead of showing both and needing a scroll
Invoiced/Uninvoiced table headers: third click on the same column clears the sort instead of toggling forever
Deadlines calendar: taller cells, more events visible per day, bigger text

releases.title: Schedule tab redesign — multi-person mini todo board
items: Schedule is now a real working board: pick which people to show (chips, remembered), drag tasks onto a different day or a different person to reschedule/reassign
No more separate to-do/done split — completed tasks just grey out and strike through in place, still draggable and clickable
Day columns no longer stretch to fit long task titles — they truncate properly now

releases.title: Fix Deadlines tab crash, Jobs/Clients reporting bugs
items: Fixed: Deadlines tab rendered nothing at all — it referenced a variable that only existed inside a different function
Fixed: Jobs report never applied the date-range filter to anything except the hours column — relabelled "Jobs shown" to "Active in period" so the count actually moves with the dropdown
Fixed: Clients report dropped any client with invoices but no logged time that period entirely, instead of showing $0/0h

releases.title: Expense detail modal, starred-in-search, invoiced/uninvoiced table parity
items: Expenses list: clicking a row now opens an expense detail modal (same fields as the job-plan Expenses tab) instead of jumping straight to the job
Global search: star icon in the search bar surfaces starred jobs/clients/quotes/invoices directly in results
Uninvoiced jobs table columns now align to the Invoiced table; both get sortable column headers
Uninvoiced rows can be hidden — persisted so stale ones don\'t reappear on the next Streamtime sync
Dropped the "#" prefix on job numbers in the Invoiced table and quote chips

releases.title: Job timeline, starred items panel, native quote creation
items: New Job Timeline tab on job detail — phase-level Gantt-style view built from phase start/due dates
New Starred panel — star any job or client, browse them in one place
New quote creation — "New quote" modal on the Quotes list and job detail, with print preview, alongside real Streamtime quotes

releases.title: Phase dates, quote versioning, split invoicing, contact title on print
items: Job detail: phase date ranges now shown on the Job Plan tab (calendar chip per phase)
Quotes: local version history — "Revise quote" saves a new value/note without touching the Streamtime record
Invoices: deposit/split invoicing — raise named partial invoices (% or $) against a job, each with its own status
Invoice and quote print previews now show the client contact\'s job title underneath their name
Fixed: tasks marked complete in Streamtime without logging time were invisible in the Done column — now cross-checked against job assignment completion status

Streamtime sync: added a 15-minute fast sync for logged time/scheduled todos/assignments (previously only hourly), plus a checkpointed deep-history backfill so Reporting can reach back past the last ~12 months over time

releases.title: Budget total fix, quote/invoice document preview, non-billable rates, data-freshness indicator
items: Fixed: jobs $ budget total was way over (e.g. $920k vs Streamtime $704k) — it fell back to "planned time" for jobs with no agreed budget. Now uses finalBudget like Streamtime, so the footer total matches
New: clicking a quote or invoice opens a full branded document preview (C&C letterhead, line items from the job plan, GST, totals, paid/balance) instead of just a details strip

Non-billable phases/items: rate is now always editable (shows a "+ rate" you can click to add one, even on a non-billable job). Billable is a job-level setting and defaults to billable — no more guessing from a $0 rate
New: Todo board shows a "Streamtime data through <date>" indicator — turns orange when today isn\'t synced yet, so it\'s clear when completed tasks just haven\'t exported, not gone missing

releases.title: Platform-wide data audit — billable %, quotes, invoices, paused filter, per-job totals
items: Fixed: billable vs non-billable was wrong everywhere — logged time read a field that doesn\'t exist (isBillable lives on the job), so ALL hours counted as billable. 1,760 of 5,359 logged entries (33%) are actually non-billable. Corrects dashboard split, Business %-billable KPI, People utilisation, and the Time view billable stat/filter

Fixed: the entire Quotes screen was mis-mapped — company (a plain string), quote name & number, and "sent by" all showed blank or raw IDs; company filter/dropdown/group-by were non-functional. Now read the correct Streamtime fields
Fixed: Invoice "Job" column / detail / filter / group-by were always blank — invoices carry a jobId, not a job number/name; now resolved from the linked job
Fixed: Jobs "Paused" status filter & group-by never matched (paused jobs are stored as In Play + a separate flag) — 8 paused jobs now filter correctly
Fixed: Progress-tab per-row "Sell" and Time-view "Revenue" were re-estimated at a flat rate instead of using the real logged sell value — now reconcile with Streamtime
Fixed: invoice issued/paid totals grossed-up ex-tax by a flat 15% instead of using the real inc-GST amounts (wrong when discounts apply)
Fixed: three more "job 123 matches job 1234" substring bugs that pulled unrelated jobs\' hours/notes into a job\'s totals
Removed: "Quotes expiring soon" dashboard card and quote expiry filters — Streamtime\'s export carries no quote expiry date, so they never worked
Add-team-member and new-client modals no longer stack duplicates if reopened

releases.title: Job detail crash fix, Progress reallocate restored, budget total fix, expenses data fix, todo cleanup
items: Fixed: jobs with a due date set failed to open at all (job detail crashed on a missing fmtDate reference) — affected job 6860 and others
Fixed: Progress tab reallocate menu (⋮) was hidden on every row, ST-sourced or not — restored, and fixed the underlying week lookup so it actually finds the entry to move
Fixed: Quote tab stacked a duplicate "Streamtime Quotes" block every time you switched tabs and back — was inserted outside the area that gets cleared on re-render
Fixed: Jobs list budget total didn\'t match Streamtime — was reading totalPlannedTimeExTax first instead of finalBudget

Fixed: Expenses list showed $0 cost/sell and always "Draft" status — was reading the wrong field names from the Streamtime export (totalCost/totalExTax/itemName, status is a plain string not an object)
Fixed: "Hours" view setting had no effect on initial render — only worked while actively resizing a card
Fixed: "Notes" view setting now actually hides the note text baked into task titles, falling back to the item/job name — relabelled "Notes (in task title)" for clarity
View settings panel now shows a "drag to reorder" hint and a visible grip icon on each row
Removed: Log Time button (Todo bar + job detail), Plan My Week, and My Items panel — redundant with Add Task

releases.title: Phase 2 foundations — Log Time, Schedule, My Items, Global Search, Expenses list, Add Phase/Item
items: New: Log Time — create time entries natively from the Todo bar (persists locally, Phase 2 API-ready)
New: My Items panel — see all job items assigned to you across all active jobs
New: Plan My Week — auto-distribute remaining item hours across Mon-Fri based on your capacity
New: Schedule view — team week-at-a-glance showing hours/capacity per person per day
New: Global Search (⌘K) — search across jobs, clients, invoices and quotes
New: Expenses list — cross-job expense view with search, filters, status and client breakdown
New: Add expense from Expenses tab with job, description, cost and sell fields
New: Add Phase to any job — creates a new phase in the job plan
New: Add Item to any phase — with planned hours and rate
Architecture: DB stub layer added — all native-create functions ready to swap localStorage for real API calls

releases.title: Settings overhaul, invoice merge, client folder nav, reporting filters, data connections, bug fixes
items: Settings: replaced accordion layout with sidebar navigation — My Profile, Team, Workspace Defaults, Job Items, Labels, Workspace Sync, Data, About tabs
Team tab: rich member card grid showing role, cost rate, billable rate, and hours/day per person
Team tab: click any team member card to open a detail slide-out panel with full profile editing — name, role, team, cost rate, hours/day, colour picker, archive
My Profile tab: inline editing of name, role, team, colour, cost rate and hours/day — no redirect to Team tab
My Profile tab: click avatar in sidenav profile card to open My Profile tab directly
My Profile tab: dashboard team filter toggles and block visibility controls — changes now live-update the dashboard immediately (bug fix)
Data tab: Streamtime connection card with live sync counts; "coming soon" integrations — Xero, Google Calendar, Slack, Google Sheets
Invoices: merged "To Be Invoiced" and "All Invoices" tabs into a single view — Uninvoiced jobs appears as a collapsible section above the invoice table when the checkbox is ticked
Jobs: Uninvoiced chip filter now works correctly — finds completed jobs with no invoicing
Clients: group folder headers are now clickable — navigates to a full sub-view of that group with header stats and individual client cards; Back button returns to main client list
Reporting: Business tab company filter — filter all KPIs, charts and the YoY table by a single client
Reporting: Year-over-year revenue breakdown table on Business tab — shows invoiced and paid totals for every year across all historical ST data
Reporting: People, Jobs, and Clients tabs now have data-driven filter selects populated from the live dataset
Bug fix: Settings sidenav profile card now updates instantly when you change your name or colour on the My Profile tab
Bug fix: Uninvoiced jobs (TBI) filter no longer shows already-invoiced completed jobs

releases.title: Jobs filters, client groups, quote detail drawer, activity timeline, studio board fix, default cost rate in Settings
items: Jobs: replaced 6 dropdown filters with stackable chip filter system — filter by status, workflow, company, label, health, PO, lead, member, billable, due/start date range, budget range
Jobs: group by Company, Status, Workflow, or Lead — same preset save/load as Quotes and Invoices
Clients: master client grouping — set a Group field on any client, clients with the same group are shown under a shared header in the list with combined job and revenue stats
Clients: group field searchable and editable in client detail info strip; autocomplete from existing groups
Quotes + Invoices: click "View detail" on any quote or invoice card to open a slide-out drawer with full ST data (dates, amounts, PO, linked job, open job button)
Job detail Quote tab: Streamtime quotes linked to this job shown above the quote document as a clickable list — supports multiple quotes per job
Activity tab: full timeline redesign — date-group headers (Today, Yesterday, weekday name, full date), card layout with avatar, Streamtime vs local badge, and time stamp
Studio board: fixed — the Studio board preset now creates live job cards with hours/budget bars, workflow badge, and team avatars instead of plain note cards
Settings: new Workspace Defaults section — set company-wide default cost rate and invoice payment terms; default cost rate is used wherever Streamtime returns $0 for a user
All $150 hardcoded cost rate fallbacks now read from the workspace default setting
Dropdown (cc-select) styling: refined arrow, hover state, focus ring — consistent across all panels

releases.title: Smart filter system for Quotes and Invoices — stackable filters, group-by, saved presets, job numbers, $150 default cost rate
items: Quotes and Invoices: stackable AND filter chips — filter by status, company, job number, job name, PO, lead, value/amount range, sent/due/paid/expiry date ranges
Filter chips are saveable as named presets (stored in localStorage, one click to reload)
Group by Status, Company, or Job on both Quotes and Invoices tables
Job number now shown prominently on every quote card header (#jobNum chip below quote number)
Job number shown with # prefix in invoice table Job column
Quote search now includes job number in scope
All historical quotes and invoices visible — no date cutoff applied
Default cost rate set to $150/h when Streamtime returns 0 for a user (resolves profitability data gap)
PO number on invoices now reads from invoice purchaseOrderNumber field first, then falls back to linked job PO

releases.title: Full roadmap sweep — address, expiry alerts, DSO, invoice filters, date range, capacity, studio board, uninvoiced report
items: Client detail: company address shown when mapped from Streamtime
Invoice print: client address appears on the tax invoice when available
Dashboard: "Quotes expiring soon" alert card — quotes expiring within 14 days appear in Needs attention
Invoices: PO number column in All Invoices table — linked from job PO
Invoices: status filter (Overdue / Sent / Awaiting / Paid / Draft / Voided) in All Invoices
Invoices: DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) shown in toolbar — average days from sent to paid
Reporting: custom date-range picker — select any From/To dates for precise period analysis
Todo: day header tints amber when person is at or over capacity for the day
Todo: day capacity now uses per-person Hrs/day from Settings (not hardcoded 8h)
Boards: "Studio board" one-click preset — creates a board of all live jobs grouped by workflow stage (Quote / Live / Completed / Invoiced)
Reporting → Business: Uninvoiced work table — all jobs with a gap between revenue logged and invoiced, sorted by gap size

releases.title: PO tracking, deadline calendar, rollover prompt, contact management, per-person rates
items: Jobs: PO filter (All / Has PO / No PO) — instantly see which jobs have a purchase order
Jobs: PO number shown in status column of jobs table for quick scanning
New Deadlines tab — month-view calendar of all job due dates and unpaid invoice due dates, colour-coded and clickable
Monday rollover prompt — on the first open each Monday, shows count of unfinished tasks from last week with quick link to review them
Clients: Add / edit / delete local contacts per client (alongside read-only Streamtime contacts)
Settings: per-person Hours/day and Rate $/h fields — sets working hours and default hourly rate for each team member

releases.title: Big roadmap push — data fixes, intelligence & analytics
items: Fixed a Streamtime sync bug that had quotes and invoices swapped — the Quotes tab now shows real quote status & value, and Invoices show real status, due date, paid date and overdue flags.
Dashboard "Needs attention": jobs due/overdue, overdue invoices, quotes awaiting response, uninvoiced work, and quiet clients — all from live data.
Dashboard customisation: show/hide the Needs attention, Team, Business KPIs and Clients blocks (Settings → Dashboard).
Reporting: utilisation % per person (billable vs capacity), monthly client revenue trend, and a quote→cash pipeline funnel.
Jobs list: budget-health filter (on track / at risk / over / needs attention). Fixed over-budget alerts that were silently empty.
Clients: search by name/contact/email, sort by jobs or revenue, active-only filter; company website now shows and links.
Calendar: hour gridlines now align with cards.
Workspace backup: export/import all local data as a JSON file (Settings → Data).

releases.title: Card colours, urgent fix, activity & expense detail
items: Every todo card now shares one design; the left border colour shows status — green billable, amber non-billable, red urgent — matching the dashboard bars.
Fixed: marking a task urgent now actually shows red (a styling conflict was hiding it).
Done buckets now collapse uniformly across the week (triggered by the lightest day) for a calmer view.
Dashboard loads fully on first open (no need to visit To Do first), and uses your real Streamtime weekly capacity (e.g. 40h) instead of a fixed 30h.
Dashboard stat bars now read green when healthy; the billable bar fills green toward your capacity.
"Add more time?" follow-up now pre-fills the new task with the job, item, hours and title.
Task notes now fall back to the Streamtime schedule note, so more notes come through; repeating tasks show as their individual dated blocks.
Job team: the + picker is now searchable and active-only, and anyone who has logged or scheduled time on the job is added automatically.
Job Activity tab now lists everyone who logged time on the job (from Streamtime), with their notes and dates.
Expenses: a single expense line (e.g. Disbursements) can be itemised into editable sub-lines that total up — see job 6964. Edits are local for now.
Job detail shows the PO number when Streamtime has one.

releases.title: Streamtime is the source of truth
items: The Todo board now reads entirely from Streamtime — scheduled blocks are your to-dos, logged blocks are done. The old manual-task layer is gone.
Everything is editable: drag, resize, edit, mark done, move between days. Changes apply instantly but are local — they revert on refresh until Streamtime write-back is added.
Dashboard now counts planned to-dos, not just done: "Billable this week" shows done + planned against your real Streamtime weekly capacity.
Team blocks and "My tasks today" now show each person\'s scheduled Streamtime to-dos.
Todo buckets are now per-day: a day collapses to a summary only when its own cards can\'t fit — light days keep showing cards even when a busy day buckets.
The bucket "View" button now glides the divider smoothly to reveal that zone.
Calendar: done blocks now stack above to-do blocks for each day.

releases.title: Todo bucket timing, today line, billable accuracy
items: Todo bucket now appears as soon as a day\'s tasks no longer fit at a readable size (not only when the divider is dragged near the top)
Fixed: the "today" red indicator no longer adds height to that column\'s header, so the done divider and padding line up across all days
More consistent breathing room under the done divider
Fixed billable accuracy: logged-time billable status is read from the job (was always counting as billable) — dashboard billable hours and capacity bars are now correct

releases.title: Real scheduled ToDo blocks from Streamtime
items: Todo board now reads actual Streamtime "Scheduled" ToDo blocks — each planned block shows with its own note, exact date, and exact minutes
Notes pull through correctly: the block note (e.g. "🥫 RECORP - New Can Spec Sheet") is the task title
Multiple blocks for the same job+item are kept as separate tasks (each is its own scheduled block)
No more aggregate/spanning assignments cluttering every day — blocks sit only on their real scheduled day
Done column reads "Logged" blocks; to-do column reads "Scheduled" blocks — Streamtime moves a block between them when completed, so no duplication
Removed the per-block note duplication on cards (note shown once, as the title)
New data file scheduled_todos.json synced hourly from Streamtime

releases.title: Assignment dedup, notes, and display fixes
items: Assignments now appear once per week on their first applicable day — no more repeating the same card Mon–Fri
Assignment card notes: uses item description when available, falls back to most recent logged-time note for same job+item
Removed dedup between ST assignments and logged times — assignments show remaining work, logged entries show done work; these coexist correctly
Manual todo dedup now per-day only: a manual task for job+item moves to done if time was logged against that exact job+item on that same day
Removed 30-day span filter — retainer and long-running assignments correctly appear again
Calendar view uses same per-day manual-todo dedup logic (ST assignments never deduped)

releases.title: Fix assignment clutter and dedup accuracy
items: Assignment filter: skip items with 0 planned/incomplete minutes (nothing to show)
Assignment filter: skip retainer-style items spanning more than 30 days (they were flooding every week)
Dedup now uses week-level matching — if a job+item was logged on any day this week, matching todo/assignment cards are removed from all days (not just the day the time was logged)
Day header stats (To do / Done) now reflect post-dedup values
Calendar view dedup also upgraded to week-level matching

releases.title: Todo/done dedup, notes fix, hours per day
items: Fixed: manual todo tasks no longer show as todo when ST has already logged time for the same job+item on the same day — they move to the done zone
Fixed: ST planned assignment hours now divided across days active this week (not total on every day)
Fixed: item description now included in mapped job items — assignment cards show notes correctly
Dedup applied in both list view and calendar view

releases.title: Planned assignment hours & notes fix
items: Fixed planned ST assignment hours — total minutes now divided by working days in span (was showing total on every day)
Item description now used as card note on planned assignments
Item estimated dates used as fallback when assignment has no start/end dates
Duplicate info lookup removed from inner loop

releases.title: Done divider, NaN fix, expenses & paused phases
items: Fixed NaN in phase header sell totals — em-dash items (no planned hours) now correctly count as $0
Fixed expenses not loading from ST — corrected field names (jobNumber, costRate, loggedExpenseStatus)
Fixed paused phases from ST — phases where all items are Paused now render as paused
Done divider bar now has a distinct warm grey colour so it stands out from the background
Removed the "N done hidden" overflow pill from the done zone (redundant with bucket view)
Fixed done cards clipping behind divider bar — restored 24px top padding on done zone

releases.title: Bug fixes, collapsible settings & card improvements
items: Fixed jobs not opening when job has no phases or is missing data (null guard + ST jobs default to empty phases)
Fixed expenses tab — now shows expenses from Streamtime data (stExpenses) merged with manual entries, with ST badge
Fixed paused phases from ST — handles both jobPhaseStatus and status field names from subdomain API
Removed Done zone watermark leftover padding
Todo cards now have a minimum height (52px) so title + hours are always readable
Settings sections are now collapsible — Team open by default, all others collapsed

releases.title: Data fixes, expenses & assignments sync
items: Fixed job due dates — now correctly reads estimatedStartDate/estimatedEndDate from ST (deadline badges now work)
Fixed user capacity — reads hoursWorkedMonday…Friday per-day values instead of null capacity field
Fixed user billableRate — mapped from correct ST field
Sync now pulls expenses (view 9), job assignments/planned hours (view 17), milestones (view 18)
ST planned assignments now appear in the Todo zone — shows what you\'re scheduled to work on this week

releases.title: Zone buckets, fill-to-zone cards, paused jobs fix
items: Todo/Done zones collapse to summary buckets ("N To Do\'s · Xh · view") when dragged too small
Done zone shows "N Done · Xh · view" bucket with View ↓ to expand
Task cards now fill their zone — cards stretch proportionally so total height equals zone height
Progressive info: icon/hours/job/note hide/show smoothly as cards resize during drag
Done zone watermark "Done" text in background when cards are present
ST Paused jobs now show as In Play + Paused badge (matching platform pause behaviour)

releases.title: ST task drag, done-bar resize, job budgets, quick wins
items: ST logged-time tasks are now draggable — drag to another day or to To Do; always clones (ST is read-only)
Done-bar drag now resizes both todo AND done cards based on their zone height
Done zone collapse pill: "N done hidden · Xh · View ↓" when done area is too small
Job phase budget hours fixed — phases now show planned/budgeted hours not logged hours
Job detail: due date badge in meta line; overdue and due-within-7-days highlighted
Dashboard: new Deadlines section lists overdue and due-soon live jobs
Quotes: real ST status (Approved / Declined / Sent / Draft); value, expiry, approved/declined dates shown
Quotes: Expiring soon / Expired badges on quotes near or past expiry date
Invoices: due date column; overdue highlighted in red with day count; real ST status used
Clients: website link from ST shown on client detail page
Users: ST capacity (hours/day) now mapped from users.json

releases.title: Todo: arrow keys, drag fixes, data warning
items: Arrow keys ← → navigate between weeks on the todo view
Alt+drag to duplicate tasks to another day (existing feature now documented in changelog)
Done-bar drag: task cards in the Done zone no longer shrink/hide content while dragging
Todo cards stay at least 52px tall while dragging the done bar — info stays visible
Warning banner shown when Streamtime logged-time data fails to load
Streamtime sync script: 180s timeout, 500-record pages, backup file, exponential retry for large datasets

releases.title: Job avatar stack shows active users only
items: Avatar stack on job plan items now filters to active Streamtime users only
Hibernated and Deleted users are hidden from the main avatar row
+N overflow chip still shows inactive users in the tooltip, marked "(inactive)" so time history is preserved
userStatus (Active/Hibernated/Deleted) now stored on every user in stUsersById

releases.title: Fix ST card interactions, reporting, jobs sort, budget accuracy
items: Fixed: hover tooltip and right-click menu now work on Streamtime logged-time cards (same as manual tasks)
Fixed: Reporting pages no longer blank — null filter elements no longer crash getFilteredTasks()
Fixed: Jobs always sort newest-first regardless of "hide archived" state (uses internal ST ID)
Fixed: +N avatar chip now shows full team hours breakdown on hover
Fixed: Job footer totals now include logged expenses in the used amount
Fixed: Planned budget now uses totalPlannedTimeExTax (matching Streamtime\'s Budget column)

releases.title: Accurate NZD costs
items: Fixed: monetary values from Streamtime now preserved with full cent precision (no more Math.round per job)
Totals in the jobs footer now match Streamtime cent-for-cent

releases.title: Lucide icons, jobs lazy loading, data roadmap
items: Site-wide icon library migrated to Lucide — crisp SVG icons replace Tabler font icons
ITEM_ICONS expanded to 30+ job type mappings (palette, video, film, camera, pen-line, etc.)
Jobs page now lazy-loads in batches of 60 — first render is instant, more load as you scroll
IntersectionObserver sentinel shows "Showing X of Y — scroll for more" with auto-load on scroll
ROADMAP.md written: full audit of all 7 ST datasets, what\'s wired vs available, 20 proposed features
Key data gaps identified: user capacity, profitability, job deadlines, quote status, invoice due dates

releases.title: Todo overflow pill and divider flash fix
items: When done bar is dragged up and todos overflow: sticky pill shows "N hidden · Xh" with View ↑ button
View ↑ button expands the divider just enough to reveal all hidden tasks
Fixed: done bar no longer flashes at y=0 when clicking a task card (pre-positioned before DOM insert)
Overflow pill updates live after every drag-end

releases.title: Reporting fixed, todo improvements, jobs footer totals
items: Fixed: reporting pages no longer blank — nav now calls _buildTabFilters on first load
Fixed: ST data now loads immediately on site open (not only after visiting todo tab)
Todo task cards always show hours regardless of card height
Todo summary bar: hover to see per-day breakdown (Mon–Fri, To Do / Done columns)
Right-click anywhere on todo board background → Add task menu at that day
Jobs footer bar: TOTAL (N) with $used / $budget progress bar and over-budget count
Jobs sort is NaN-safe — non-numeric IDs sort to bottom consistently

releases.title: Reporting redesign, non-billable clarity, avatar breakdown
items: Reporting page now has four sub-tabs: Business, People, Jobs, Clients
Business tab: KPIs (total hours, billable %, revenue invoiced, active jobs), hours trend chart, billable split doughnut, over-budget job list
People tab: per-person cards with hours and billable %, hours-by-person bar chart, hours-by-day chart, full breakdown table
Jobs tab: filters by status and client, hours-by-job and budget-used charts, scrollable job list with inline progress bars
Clients tab: client cards with hours / jobs / revenue, hours and revenue charts
Export CSV scoped to the active tab and current filters
Non-billable items: hours column now shows just the logged hours without "/ 0h" — no more misleading red over-budget appearance
+N team avatar overflow chip now shows a hover tooltip listing every team member and their hours

releases.title: Streamtime data fully unified — todos, calendar, dashboard, reporting
items: ST logged time entries now render identically to manual tasks — same card style, hover tooltip, colours, and click-to-view modal
Todo list: done cards from Streamtime show job chip, item name, billable colour, and hours — no longer plain grey blocks
Todo calendar: ST entries appear in the Completed drawer and are clickable
Clicking any ST card opens a modal showing all entry details (title, hours, job, item) with a Streamtime source badge
Day capacity bar now counts ST logged hours in the done/billable split — bar fills correctly
Dashboard "Billable this week" and "My tasks today" include ST logged time
Reporting charts and table now pull from Streamtime logged_times as primary source with period/person/job filters
Job time tab entry titles now show the note written in Streamtime (not just item name)
Job plan: team avatar stack per item — shows who logged time with hover showing name + hours
Job plan: non-billable phases show lock badge and $0 / $0 with a tooltip, matching Streamtime display
ST done cards link directly to the relevant job when clicked

releases.title: Invoice overhaul, person picker teams, item progress bars, undo
items: Invoices page redesigned as a table with Company, Issue date, Inv #, Job, Due date, Status, Amount columns
"To Be Invoiced" filter built into Invoices page — shows completed jobs ready to bill; "All Invoices" shows full history
Invoice ⋮ menu: view, open job, mark as Draft/Sent/Paid, delete invoice record
Overdue invoices auto-detected and shown in red when past due date and not paid
Todo person picker now groups team members by team with headers
Job plan: each item shows a thin progress bar — green/amber/red based on logged vs planned hours
Phase delete now shows an 8-second Undo toast instead of a confirm dialog
"To Be Invoiced" subnav tab removed — functionality merged into Invoices tab

releases.title: Client nicknames, job status overhaul, pause, dashboard task adding
items: URLs in job notes and task notes are now clickable hyperlinks
Todo task modal: removed per-task notes; job\'s own brief now shows as read-only context when a job is selected
Clients: add a short name / nickname (e.g. SFF) — appears in dropdowns, client list, and client cards on dashboard
Approving a quote now automatically moves the job from Quote → Live Job
New workflow stage: Completed (between Live and Invoiced) — jobs marked Completed appear in the new "To Be Invoiced" tab
Pause jobs and phases — paused jobs/phases show a badge and block time logging
Dashboard: "+" button on Your Day and each team member card to add tasks directly
Dashboard: new Clients section showing active clients with their live jobs
Jobs list: label filter added; workflow filter includes Completed

releases.title: Searchable pickers, drag fixes, repeats that actually repeat
items: Client fields (job settings + new job) are now searchable dropdowns of all clients; add-item gets the same treatment for the item list
Fixed: reordering tasks in the day list now drops exactly where the red line shows (the indicator was being cleared before it was read)
Dragging the Done line now tidies card content live while you drag, not after release
Calendar: resizing a block reflows the blocks below it live
Fixed: turning Repeat on while editing an existing task now books future weeks (previously only brand-new tasks repeated)
Repeating tasks show a repeat icon on list cards and calendar blocks
Fixed: task modal Delete now sits beside Save (two auto-margins had parked it mid-footer)
Boards: one-time cleanup of cards the old id-collision bug had copied into multiple boards; Client/People boards are labelled “live view” to show they mirror live data by design

releases.title: Resize is back, job numbers fixed, board deletes fixed
items: Todo list: edge-resize on task cards is back, and dragging the Done line rescales all cards live (relative to their hours)
Fixed: job numbers no longer duplicate — numbering continues from the highest existing number, duplicates from before are auto-renumbered
Task cards now show the live job name (renaming a job updates every task)
Fixed: board delete and column delete did nothing (confirm dialog lost its callback)
Task modal: Delete is back — underlined, left of Save (it was invisible due to a CSS clash)
Time view: per-person groups start minimised — summary first, click to expand
Settings: new My Profile section — choose which teams appear on your dashboard
Removed ~700 lines of dead legacy code (an entire inert script block and an orphaned calendar view)

releases.title: Progress tab, real logo, teams & a deep consistency pass
items: Job plan: new Progress tab — per-person time table (logged & scheduled) with one-click reallocation of time to another item or job
Fixed: done todos now reliably feed job plan item hours (stale item links fall back to name matching)
Fixed: job plan Sell \u201cused\u201d now computed live from logged hours \u00d7 item rate
Fixed: item picker now explains when a job has no plan items (was a confusing \u201cSelect a job first\u201d)
Fixed: priority boards no longer share columns/cards (id collisions); new boards default to Custom
C&C logo now appears on quotes and invoices (and prints)
Team members can be assigned a team in Settings — dashboard and reporting group by it
Todo list: cards are content-sized with even gaps (calendar keeps time-blocks)
Task & expense forms: proper field styling (the form-inp class had no CSS at all)
Consistent page titles, spacing and paddings across all views

releases.title: MVP milestone — search, print, real team management
items: Global search: press ⌘K (or the sidebar magnifier) to search jobs, clients, tasks and plan items
Team members now persist — add and remove people from Settings, no code edit needed
Quote + invoice Print / PDF: clean print stylesheet, Send quote marks it sent
Invoiced ex GST stat in the job plan now reads from the real invoice total
Jobs list: bulk select with Archive / Delete / Label actions; Hide archived now works
Global labels: manage in Settings, pick from the list on any job (coloured chips everywhere)
Designed empty states for jobs, schedule, boards and clients
Keyboard: Esc closes any modal, N adds a task in the schedule view
Activity log now covers task add/edit/delete/done, item edits, team and note changes

releases.title: Stats fix, quote redesign, Create dropdown, calendar improvements
items: Job plan stats: compute live from phases (hours, sell, logged) — no more stale $0
Quote tab: full Streamtime-style redesign with display options panel and T&Cs
Job plan: Create dropdown (Item, Phase, To Do, Expense, Invoice, Quote)
Job plan: Settings gear modal and 3-dot menu (Duplicate, Star, Archive, Delete)
Calendar: Show completed toggle filter; right-click context menu on blocks
Calendar: Edge-resize task blocks to change hours; Alt+drag to duplicate
Clients: Lead field (assign from team); shown on card and detail
Job detail: Lead shown in meta line, auto-defaulting from client record
Expenses: Restyled section with better table and status badges
Priority boards: wider columns (280px), better card content wrapping

releases.title: MVP polish — context menus, inline expenses, toast UI
items: Calendar: "Done" divider no longer bleeds into calendar view
Calendar: drag tasks between days; drop to drawer marks done
Calendar: fullscreen completed view — see done tasks in day columns
Calendar: drawer is larger, cleaner, no distracting hint text
Job plan: Hours column now shows logged/planned (e.g. 2h30m / 6h); Sell column restored
Job plan: Add expense inline (next to Add item) with predefined list
Workflow advance: styled confirmation modal (no more browser confirm)
Right-click on any task card: Edit, Duplicate, Reassign, Mark done, Go to job, Delete
Toast notifications replace browser alert() dialogs
Person card in boards: hours bar, capacity %, task count, urgent flag
Settings: manage Job Plan items and Expense types (add/remove)
Sidebar wider (68px), icons larger
Task card title stays same size while resizing

releases.title: Calendar view, boards, job plan hours & polish
items: New: Calendar view for todo — filter by type, drag tasks to "done" drawer
Calendar: completed tasks drawer with drag-to-complete support
Calendar: filter chips (Personal / Job tasks / Urgent only / Time toggle)
Boards: Add column now lets you choose Generic, Client, or Person type
Boards: Client column auto-fills with all active jobs for that client
Job plan: Logged / Planned hours column — shows hours from completed todos vs. plan
Job plan: Workflow badge is now clickable to advance Quote → Live → Invoiced
Expenses: completely rebuilt form with live sell-price preview
Task cards: content responds live as you resize (title → hours → job → note)
Delete task button now has a clear visual style in the task modal
Sidebar: nicer hover states; removed duplicate Calendar nav item
Modals: wider across the board for more comfortable editing

releases.title: Job plans, reporting & repeat tasks
items: Fixed: job plans now open correctly from any job in the list
Fixed: reporting charts now display data correctly (Chart.js data structure corrected)
Improved: calendar icon in task modal now opens a proper date picker
Improved: repeat task feature — choose to repeat Never, After N occurrences, or until a specific date
Improved: repeat tasks skip weekends automatically
Added: this changelog — shown on first load after each update

releases.title: Jobs sub-tabs & clients
items: Jobs page now has sub-tabs: Jobs, Time, Expenses, Quotes, Invoices, Clients
Clients tab added — auto-populated from jobs data
Job workflow status: Quote → Live Job → Invoiced
Job plan items are now inline-editable (click hours or rate to edit)
Dynamic team member avatars in job detail header (clickable)
Task modal redesigned — personal mode, calendar icon, repeat button
Task modal: reassign task to another team member
Custom job plan line items with free-text or datalist suggestions
Site-wide dropdown styling (.cc-select)
